query_analysis.original_query: In a solvent recovery system using distillation, how do we ensure compliance with safety standards for handling flammable solvents like ethanol?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Identify and implement safety measures and procedures to ensure compliance with relevant safety standards when handling flammable solvents like ethanol in a solvent recovery system utilizing distillation.

selected_agents.role: Identify relevant safety standards and compliance requirements
Evaluate distillation system design for safety compliance

communication_strategy.information_flow: Safety standards and compliance requirements communicated to Separation Technologist for system evaluation
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative safety assessment and design optimization

clarification_questions: What specific flammable solvents are being recovered in the distillation system?
Are there any existing safety measures or protocols in place for the solvent recovery process?
What are the operating conditions (temperature, pressure) of the distillation system?
